source: Statistics Bureau of Japan Labour Force Survey Basic Tabulation release schedule and official survey handbook

policy.release_date: Use the date printed in the archived monthly preliminary Labour Force Survey PDF for each reference month.
policy.exception_policy: If an official year-specific schedule documents a different release time for a specific release, override only that release explicitly; never infer an alternate intraday time.
policy.market_entry_rule: For daily FX/rates replay, use the first market observation strictly after the release timestamp; never use a same-day close if its information-set ordering is ambiguous.

official_evidence: Statistics Bureau publication schedule: Labour Force Survey Basic Tabulation is released at 08:30 JST as the standard release time.
Official Labour Force Survey handbook states monthly Basic Tabulation release time is 08:30.
Archived monthly preliminary PDFs preserve publication-time values and release dates; current historical tables may be retrospectively revised and are not substituted.
guardrails: no inferred intraday timestamp beyond official 08:30 JST policy
scope: JPY Labour PIT activation only; does not imply JPY Growth PIT or full JPY Macro readiness.
